notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
-Fixed the issue with water no longer showing up.... what a frustrating mess :) but we are back in action now!
-I removed the ability to restart a mission in multiplayer.. TEMPORARILY... you can still restart in singleplayer... but the restart continues to fail in production... apologies, hoping to have this fixed soon. For now, simply return to Lobby then relaunch from there. Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: 🔥 Champion of Andia is Out Now! Join the Fight! ⚔️
notes.content:
[h2]🎉 The Battle Begins – Champion of Andia is Now Live! [/h2]

Warriors, the time has come! Champion of Andia, our RPG arena fighter, has officially launched! Now, you can dive into tactical, skill-based battles—whether solo or with friends.

🔥 What to Expect:
✅ Intense PvP and Co-op battles
✅ A deep leveling system to customize your fighter
✅ Powerful magic to dominate the arena
✅ Challenging foes and endless action

I want to take a moment to thank our incredible community for your support during development! Your feedback has shaped the game, and I can’t wait to see the battles unfold.

⚔️ Join the fight now and become the Champion of Andia!


[h2]A Personal Note from the Developer (Me!)[/h2]
Game development as a solo dev has been an amazing journey! Over four years ago, I set out to learn how to make a video game. What followed were countless late nights filled with frustration, excitement, misery, and joy—all leading up to today.

Game dev has been SO much harder than I ever imagined, but it has also been the most rewarding thing I've ever done.

That said, this is just the beginning! I have so many ideas for Champion of Andia, and development is FAR from over. Your feedback will help shape the future of the game—together, we can make it the best it can possibly be!

💬 Join the conversation! Let us know your thoughts, share your best moments, and connect with fellow warriors in the community.
